api_version: Public data.gouv.fr dataset-catalogue v1 only (anonymous); separate account-gated Météo-France Climatologie API is not this interface; hourly department/decade CSV.GZ and exact wind variable not pinned

request_contract.parameter_rules: Documentation-only, no automatic source request or caller-selected path, unbounded domain, secrets, crawler, bulk extraction or retries. Metadata path(s) are only candidate exact origins; actual provider GET requires independently reviewed provider machine-use terms, exact URL, byte cap, body hash and source-specific approved workflow. The separate official Météo-France Climatologie API at portail-api.meteofrance.fr/web/fr/api/DonneesPubliquesClimatologie is account-gated and is NOT an allowed host, path, operation or authentication mode here; access to that service requires a distinct source-specific contract and authorisation.

response_contract.format: Public dataset metadata: license, publisher, resource IDs and update timestamps. No station observations, field dictionary source bytes or hourly CSV included.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Dataset represents climatologically controlled hourly stations by French department and period. Mainland UTC vs overseas FU must be distinguished; hourly gust (not mean wind), QC flags, instrument height, units, temporal support and duplicate station lineage require exact original CSV and dictionary. Neither annual storm frequency nor insurer vulnerability, TIV or losses derived.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No independently verified rate entitlement for the anonymous data.gouv.fr dataset metadata endpoint; retain documented_only with no approved requests or schedules. The separately advertised registered Météo-France Climatologie API states a 100 requests/minute maximum on its own official API listing (checked 2026-11-14); this is NOT a rate allowance for data.gouv.fr catalogue traffic and does not grant an account or authorise automated access.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Catalogue may include 1,000+ changing official resource entries; pin one exact department, period, last_modified and file SHA before any comparison.

rights_and_policy.notes: Publisher catalog states Licence Ouverte / Open Licence 2.0. That is evidence for this named dataset at catalog level, not independently for each external CSV resource, automated server cadence, hazard/model suitability or derivatives of station measurements. Attribution, resource version and original quality dictionary remain mandatory. The publisher separately advertises an account-gated Climatologie API with its own service boundary; the dataset Open Licence 2.0 must not be interpreted as proof of API account access, authorised throughput, raw-resource publication or CAT-model approval.

notes: One public dataset JSON endpoint was accessed using an external web read on 2026-11-14, NOT through a trusted source-native GitHub runner; neither binary resource nor exact API response SHA is verified. This contract itself authorizes no HTTP requests. T0 transport distinction checked on the official French data portal on 2026-11-14: the public catalogue and registered Climatologie API are different services; the registered service advertises 100 req/min only for itself. This record does not authorise either live API probe or source-byte download.
